name: Uta no☆Prince-sama♪
original_name: うたの☆プリンスさまっ♪
source:
Find a boy and shape him into an idol. Saotome Academy is a school for all aspiring idols and performance artist. You are Nanami Haruka, one of the talented composers who squeezed into the school. All these school idols have a one purpose, they are to sign with a production company and debut.

Find the voice who could bring out the life in your songs. All the boys are potential stars, you have to draw out their full potential and their soft sides.

[From [url=http://www.play-asia.com/paOS-13-71-9f-49-en-70-3qoa.html]Play-Asia[/url]]
translation:
寻找一名少年，把他培养成偶像。早乙女学园是一所面向所有偶像与表演艺术家志愿者的学校。你将扮演七海春歌——一名凭借才华成功进入学校的作曲家。校内所有偶像都有同一个目标：与经纪公司签约并正式出道。

寻找能让你的歌曲焕发生命的声音。每个少年都是潜在的明星，你必须发掘他们的全部潜力，以及温柔的一面。

[摘自[url=http://www.play-asia.com/paOS-13-71-9f-49-en-70-3qoa.html]Play-Asia[/url]]
